d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how South Africa’s political landscape has reached a historic turning point after the ruling African National Congress (ANC) suffered its worst-ever electoral defeat in the latest municipal elections. Securing just 30.76% of the vote—a dramatic 14-percentage-point drop from 2021—the ANC failed to win a clear majority in most key areas. Frustrated voters turned away from the ANC amid 34% unemployment, rampant corruption, persistent water shortages, and chronic rolling blackouts. With over half of the nation's 213 councils hung and Cape Town remaining…
